_comment: Quarterly transparency report for /sustine. Edits = git commits = audit trail. Two cost tracks: `infra_monthly_eur` is the recurring monthly infrastructure bill (Vercel, ES, R2, embedări). `coverage.*` carries the per-tier project budgets — these are one-shot per backfill, not monthly recurring. Totals are computed in the renderer; never store derived values here. Costs in EUR. Coverage figures from monitorul/data/analyze-runs/.
